hero.title: Together we can make a <1>difference</1>!
hero.subtitle: Casa Esperança Real Crescer welcomes refugees and families in need in Brazil and brings hope to pygmy communities in Congo since 2010.

about.title: A mission born from welcoming others
about.p1: It all began with Pastor Leonardo (Laza Ndosi), a missionary since 1998, who arrived in Brazil in 2003. In Rio de Janeiro, he found African communities in Brás de Pina, Caxias, Gramacho and downtown, and began helping refugees as an interpreter at Caritas and the Federal Police, where he also taught Portuguese for several years.
about.p2: In 2010, with the help of his friend Pastor Marcos Fernandes, Casa Esperança Real Crescer was born: an NGO dedicated to helping people in need in local communities, welcoming foreigners who arrive without family, and supporting pygmy villages in Africa.
about.p3: Distribution of food baskets, free haircut and braiding days, mental health support and free dental care are some of the actions we carry out to this day.

community.title: Community social work

founder.title: Pastor Leonardo
founder.quote: With the help of God, kind-hearted people, companies and public institutions, we will continue our mission.
founder.p1: Laza Ndosi, known as Pastor Leonardo, has been a missionary since 1998, dedicated to God's work and social causes. In 2009 he started the Betesda International vision, a church to welcome foreigners and teach the word of God.
founder.p2: To this day we continue to welcome people, guide them and do social work, with many ongoing projects in Brazil and Africa.
